from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# In obs_0022: floor lamp base:
arr22 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0022.png"))
# base is circular/elliptical dark grey plate on floor:
base_m = (arr22[:, :, 0] > 60) & (arr22[:, :, 0] < 90) & (arr22[:, :, 1] > 70) & (arr22[:, :, 1] < 100) & (arr22[:, :, 2] > 80) & (arr22[:, :, 2] < 120) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 150)
y_b, x_b = np.where(base_m)
print("Lamp base y min/max:", y_b.min(), y_b.max(), "x min/max:", x_b.min(), x_b.max(), "mean x:", x_b.mean())

# Stool legs in obs_0022:
# print all pixels with y in [395, 410]
stool_m = (arr22[:, :, 0] > 60) & (arr22[:, :, 0] < 110) & (arr22[:, :, 1] > 60) & (arr22[:, :, 1] < 110) & (arr22[:, :, 2] > 60) & (arr22[:, :, 2] < 110)
y_st, x_st = np.where(stool_m & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 120) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 200))
print("Stool legs y min/max:", y_st.min(), y_st.max(), "x min/max:", x_st.min(), x_st.max())
'
